audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lucian levels 1, 3, 6 and called 4-5 and first item a coin flip, while the whys next to those rows say Fiora owns level 1, level 3 and the first-item stage.
audit.why: The mirror slice settled these exact rows from Fiora's side (phases 0, 2, 5 to Fiora; 3 to Lucian; 4 to Skill), and the packet chart matches it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 corrected in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverted from the mirror's scale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item carried generic copy instead of the two cooldowns that decide them.
audit.why: Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s; Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and drops to 16s; Lunge falls from 13s to 6s, so her engage frequency roughly doubles across the lane.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns now anchor the level-6 and first-item rows and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says Riposte "parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it" in three places.
audit.why: Riposte stuns ONLY if it blocked an immobilizing effect; otherwise it just slows. Lucian's kit has no immobilise anywhere, so Riposte can never stun him — the content layer already had this right and the full layer contradicted it. Lunge also applies on-hit effects, so her damage tracks attack speed and on-hit buys rather than raw AD.
audit.corrected: The no-stun rule stated in the full layer, and the on-hit fact added to the don'ts.

audit.why: Duelist's Dance restores health on every Vital and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies — the existing early anti-heal line is right.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Her sustained level 1 and a Lunge angled onto your vital beat you — do not over-extend before your Q spike at 2.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Her second Lunge charge and Riposte are online — she edges level 3, so trade only once the parry is spent.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Riposte — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: With Q-W-E and the Ardent Blaze speed burst you kite her Lunges and trade in bursts she cannot parry every time.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Both spike at 6 — The Culling executes a low Fiora, but a held Riposte eats the opening shots.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Her vitals plus first-item lifesteal out-sustain your poke, and one parry on your cast reverses the whole trade.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1 and parries all damage; it stuns only if it blocks an immobilise, and you have none. - Relentless Pursuit (16s) is refunded by Lightslinger hits. - Hold The Culling (110s) for the parry's downtime.

edits.before: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Riposte (24s) eats your whole string, but it cannot stun you — feint it out, then commit.

edits.before: Fiora burns Riposte on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Fiora burns Riposte on a minion — that is your 24-second window.

edits.before: That is Fiora’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Lunge applies on-hit effects — her item damage grows faster than armour helps.

edits.before: Track Fiora’s Riposte: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Riposte (24s at rank 1): it parries every shot, but with no immobilise in your kit it can never stun you.

notes: The full layer told the player Riposte would stun them; it stuns only when it parries an immobilizing effect, and Lucian has none. Content already had this right — the two layers disagreed. Chart restated from the mirror's settled rows. Left alone as unverified: the page's claim that Fiora's Vitals deal percent-max-health TRUE damage — Riot's kit text puts true damage only on Grand Challenge and says nothing about the Vital's damage type, so I did not repeat or remove it.
